options.title: The City Under Derinkuyu: How Deep Does It Go?
options.first_line: Under a town in Turkey called Derinkuyu, there's a hidden city. How deep does it go?
options.first_frame: Derinkuyu's stone houses at dusk with cars passing, the town's name on its front, the ground cut away just below the street and the depth meter waiting at zero.

options.title: What's Hidden Under Derinkuyu, Turkey?
options.first_line: Derinkuyu looks like any small town in Turkey. So what's carved under its streets?
options.first_frame: An ordinary Turkish street at dusk with traffic, the name Derinkuyu over it, and a dark doorway in the rock below the road, the depth meter at zero.

options.title: Derinkuyu Has a Second City Underground
options.first_line: A whole city is cut into the rock under Derinkuyu, in Turkey. How far down?
options.first_frame: The town at dusk above, a sliver of a lit room in the rock just under the street, the camera starting to tip down, the depth meter at zero.

why: It names the place and the hidden city in the first second, then asks a question you can only get answered by staying (how deep), while B holds the subject back and C's title is a statement with no question.
